scenarios.name: ellipse-01 Create an ellipse from three defining points

scenario_steps.name: a copy of `fixtures/cad/ellipse/empty-yz.opd` is open with Sketch1 being edited in RIGHT view
the fixture center is (20, -20) mm, first-axis point is (27, -17) mm and point on the ellipse is (18.8, -17.2) mm in sketch coordinates
the user select Ellipse and specify a center, first-axis point, and point on the ellipse
a closed oval appears and the command requests another ellipse center
the oval remains and the sketch returns to Ready
